overloads.semanticRole: Evaluates boolExpression and, if it is false, halts code execution and raises error -10518 showing messageText (or the assertion text itself if messageText is omitted); does nothing if boolExpression is true.

constraints: Assertions can be globally enabled/disabled application-wide via SET ASSERT ENABLED; when disabled, ASSERT is a no-op regardless of boolExpression.
On failure (boolExpression false) triggers error -10518 with the assertion text (or messageText if supplied) prefixed by "Assert failed:"; interceptable via an ON ERR CALL method.
